structure: Part 4 mined 16 trace zips from six spec files of the tests repo's animals project (all passed): features/country-of-origin-type-ahead.spec.ts (1), features/port-of-entry-select.spec.ts (1), features/reason-purpose-scope.spec.ts (1), pages/import-reason.spec.ts (5), pages/origin.spec.ts (7) and visual/origin-of-import.visual.spec.ts (1). All six spec files were read in full. The zips were written by a newer Playwright than the trace CLI tim installs (TraceVersionError on open), so each zip was read from its unpacked event files with jq: every action (before events), every network request (resource snapshots) and every full DOM snapshot of <main> and the page title and back link; the visual trace's screencast frame was viewed. Short names used in refs: T01 = animals-e2e-features-count-09462-ountry-code-and-persists-it-animals, T02 = animals-e2e-features-port--60da8-bmits-and-persists-the-code-animals, T03 = animals-e2e-features-reaso-187a4-ped-when-the-reason-changes-animals, T04 = animals-e2e-pages-import-r-bf303-e-renders-the-page-controls-animals, T05 = animals-e2e-pages-import-r-1dcd8-rt-reason-unchecked-on-load-animals, T06 = animals-e2e-pages-import-r-3f715-cepts-a-valid-import-reason-animals, T07 = animals-e2e-pages-import-r-1907f-arket-reason-and-accepts-it-animals, T08 = animals-e2e-pages-import-r-39ca5--the-internal-market-reason-animals, T09 = animals-e2e-pages-origin-O-bc0fa-e-renders-the-page-controls-animals, T10 = animals-e2e-pages-origin-O-556ac-he-country-selector-on-load-animals, T11 = animals-e2e-pages-origin-O-0d4b9-ccepts-valid-origin-details-animals, T12 = animals-e2e-pages-origin-O-44f41-submitted-without-a-country-animals, T13 = animals-e2e-pages-origin-O-9e670-de-is-claimed-but-not-given-animals, T14 = animals-e2e-pages-origin-O-5cbc4-on-of-origin-code-selection-animals, T15 = animals-e2e-pages-origin-O-d8fed-untry-subdivision-selection-animals, T16 = animals-e2e-visual-origin--55e4a-ge-appearance-on-first-load-animals. Page inventory in journey order: (1) Origin of the import, /live-animals/notifications/{ref}/origin, always the first page after Start a new notification on the dashboard, and re-entered from the overview task 'Where is this consignment coming from?' (pointers T01 call@288 first load, T13 call@1315 error state, T14 call@1161 and T15 call@1092 return visits, T12 call@1080 return visit with no country); (2) Main reason for import, /import-reason, reached from the overview task 'Main reason for import', with conditional reveals per reason (pointers T03 call@704 first load, call@720 and call@738 return visits, call@744 and T08 call@1082 error state); (3) Arrival details, /port-of-entry, reached from the overview task 'Arrival details', of which only the Port of entry type-ahead is in this slice (pointers T02 call@629, call@637 list open, call@659 return visit). Pages the traces pass through on the way (dashboard, commodity search, commodity details, overview, additional details, transporter details) appear only as navigation targets here and belong to other parts. Every trace except T16 and T09/T10 crosses the origin page through the shared start-notification setup (France, No, Save and continue).
